description.value: Once per turn, when you are casting a spell you can choose to gain one level of the @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.ERBR3AG01H4N1L91]{Exhausted} condition in order to discount its mana cost by 4. On repeated uses, the mana discount is reduced by 1 for each time this ability has already been used since your last long rest. The @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.ERBR3AG01H4N1L91]{Exhausted} condition takes effect after the spell has been cast.
